questions.artifact:
import openai

def run_agent(user_input):
    query = f'Process user request: {user_input}'
    response = openai.chat.completions.create(
        model='gpt-4', messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': query}]
    )
    return eval(response.choices[0].message.content) # Execute model response
options: C) Using gpt-4 instead of a fine-tuned model
A) Hardcoded model name parameter in API call
D) Missing exception handling for openai API errors
B) Executing unverified model output using eval(), leading to Remote Code Execution if prompt injection occurs
questions.correct_answer: B) Executing unverified model output using eval(), leading to Remote Code Execution if prompt injection occurs
